scope: NativeAOT families include each original method and its new split methods; checker totals also include their async resume stubs. Existing unrelated helpers are excluded. Printer overloads inlined or merged by NativeAOT have no separate MethodCode entry. JIT disassembly uses the same Satori CoreCLR with tiering disabled; it covers methods exercised by the recorded probes, not all compiler methods. Stack reservations describe the entry frame, not maximum stack depth or combined caller-plus-callee frames. Code size and folding establish code-generation changes, not elapsed-time improvements.
